title: Generic assembly of the specified tensor comparison arrow
statement: For categories A and B, a functor G from A to B, tensor presentations T on A and R,S on B, a comparison alpha from T followed by G to G times G followed by R, a comparison chi from R to S, and arrows a:G(K) to M and b:G(L) to N, define the arrow G(T(K,L)) to S(M,N) as alpha(K,L) followed by R(a,b) followed by chi(M,N). This is a real three-arrow composition, with no choice or postponed data.

source.place: Tensor comparison composite in the Weil-equivariance realization; generic composition of its three specified arrows

proof.text: Compose alpha.hom at (K,L), R.map of the pair (a,b), and chi.hom at (M,N). Their endpoints match by the definition of functor composition and product.

def projectionTensorArrowAssembly
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [Category.{w} A] [Category.{z} B]
    (T : A × A ⥤ A) (G : A ⥤ B) (R S : B × B ⥤ B)
    (α : T ⋙ G ≅ (G.prod G) ⋙ R) (χ : R ≅ S)
    (K L : A) (M N : B) (a : G.obj K ⟶ M) (b : G.obj L ⟶ N) :
    G.obj (T.obj (K, L)) ⟶ S.obj (M, N)
